commands.name: workbench
commands.description: Open the workbench (turn steps / changes / history)

children: fix the failing auth test and add an audit log call
Auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale.
Status bar frees the slot above the prompt for other plugins.
Truncate adds a Full text button; Wrap uses more lines; Scroll slides it sideways (wraps in the terminal).
Lite updates on tool calls only; Off makes no model calls.
Minimum time between two narration updates.
In Full mode, how much new text the model writes before the narration updates.
Saved to your Claude Code settings (pluginConfigs); the workbench reloads to apply.
